title: ELSEWHERE
description: One cabin past the last bar of signal. Scrolling walks the 1,900 m trail while the header loses signal, then the camera pushes through the glass door into the room.

fonts.name: Font / Sign
fonts.fallback: Avenir Next, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

sections.title: Header
sections.summary: fixed fog plank: gable-and-lit-door mark with the wordmark, four links (The walk in, The room, Three seasons, Stay) with one amber indicator that slides and scales between them, the signal readout, "Hold the cabin", and a 2 px page-progress line on its bottom edge. It lifts and gains a shadow after 80 px, stays up for the whole walk, and hides on scroll-down only once past the door. Below 960 px the links become a full-screen fir menu that opens as a clip-path circle from the toggle, with staggered links, a focus trap and Escape to close.

sections.title: Overlook (hero)
sections.summary: `overlook` full-bleed in a CSS cover box (`width: max(100%, heroHeight × 1.7917)`), so a tag ("The cabin · 1,900 m", a leader line, a pinging dot) sits on the door in plate percentages. `boughs-soft` is the layer nearest the lens. Headline "Past the last bar / of signal.", a lede ending "Scroll to walk in.", a magnetic amber "Start walking" button and a "Hold the cabin" link, and three facts (1,900 m on foot, 35 min, 0 bars at the door). The hero is sticky, so the next section slides over it. On portrait screens the copy moves up under the header and the tag's label is dropped.

sections.title: The walk in
sections.summary: (fir): headline "It takes thirty-five minutes to stop checking." A pinned `trail` photograph (a sticky band at the top on phones) zooms toward the door, a dotted amber line reveals up the steps and a "Walked 880 m" readout counts. Beside it, five posts on a rail whose amber fill grows: Road's end 0 m, The cedar gate 420 m, The plank bridge 880 m, The stone steps 1,340 m, The door 1,900 m, each with elevation, minutes in, the signal at that point, a note and a detail. Posts ahead are unlit until reached.

sections.title: Threshold
sections.summary: (the signature moment): a section 400svh tall with a sticky 100svh stage. `cabin-green` dollies into its own door while `interior` fades in and grows inside the doorway, clipped to it, until it fills the stage; `boughs` scales up and slides off to the left in front. Three caption planks cross-fade: "The light is already on." (h2), "Leave the day outside.", "Now sit down."

sections.title: The room
sections.summary: (pine): `room-detail` pinned beside "One of everything." and a numbered inventory of eight things (stove, window, sofa, stool, blanket, two mugs, forty logs, a logbook); four count-up figures (23 m², 1 window, 40 logs, 2 people); "Not in the room" (a router, a television, a clock, a doorbell, a mirror bigger than your face), each struck through by a drawn line; and a drifting band: No road, No router, No clock, One window, One stove, One trail in.

sections.title: Three seasons
sections.summary: (fir): "The valley keeps three seasons." One frame stacks the three exterior plates. A panel has three season radio buttons (Green April to August, Amber September to November, White December to March), a 12-month range input styled as a ruler with a blaze thumb, and for the chosen month: daylight, low and high, time on the trail, wood per day, nightly rate, what the valley is doing and what to bring. Crossing a season boundary wipes the next plate over the last, from the right going forward in the year and from the left going back.

sections.title: The logbook
sections.summary: (mist): "Write the weather down." Three dated, signed entries as slightly tilted pages that straighten, lift and catch pointer-following lamplight on hover. Labelled as illustrative.

sections.title: Stay
sections.summary: (fog): "Hold the cabin." A pine panel (month select tied to the ruler, a nights stepper from 2 to 7, a one or two guests control, quote lines and a total that ticks) beside a floating-label form (name, email, optional note up to 280 characters). A bad submit shakes the fields once and focuses the first invalid one; a good one shows a 900 ms loading bar, then the form lifts away and a key tag drops in with a hashed reference like `EW-7K2M9Q` and a "Held" stamp. No request is made, and the tag says nothing was sent, stored or charged.

sections.title: Footer
sections.summary: (char): the mark, "The light is on.", links, three practical notes, a giant SVG wordmark and the fiction disclaimer.
